knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Checking the rules, respecting signs and tracking results are the supporting actions. The other options break consent, honesty or the rules.
The Spam Act requires consent, sender identification and a working unsubscribe option for commercial electronic messages.
Source records let the owner compare the cost and results of each method. The other options are not purposes of tracking.

practicalCriteria: Learner selects two or three local methods, each with a stated reason and a review date.
Learner writes a one-page offer that contains no licence or insurance claim the owner cannot evidence.
Learner records the source of each of five sample enquiries in a log.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
stopWorkCriteria: Learner publishes a client photo or name without recorded consent.
